title: Computational Framework for Bézier Distributions
summary: Flexible continuous univariate distributions with bounded support are essential for accurate input modeling in stochastic simulation and decision analysis. Although Bézier distributions provide a powerful family capable of representing complex shapes, their adoption has been hindered by the lack of efficient fitting procedures and modern software implementations.
